name: claude-usage-tracker
description: Query and drive the Claude Usage Tracker from a Claude chat — 5h/weekly usage, extra-usage spend, and (when you're signed in to a team) the shared account pool + monthly ledger.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Live 5-hour/weekly utilization, context, and extra-usage spend.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Tracker live/stale, Anthropic status, and update availability.

tools.name: get_team_overview
tools.description: Team members: per-account load, month-to-date spend, near-limit accounts.

tools.name: get_team_ledger
tools.description: Team members: per-account monthly spend + tokens for a month.

port.title: Tracker port (optional)
port.description: Only set this if the tracker isn't on its default port. Leave blank to auto-detect from the tracker's server_port file (blank or invalid values are ignored).
